auth.mechanism: Supabase magic link. Logged-out protected routes redirect to /auth and preserve the destination in the next query parameter.
auth.genericHeading: Sign in to AI Use Case Atlas
auth.signOut: The account menu signs out through Supabase and returns to the home page. Protected routes then require auth again.
auth.entitlement: Any signed-in user can open the free Starter Kit. Premium entitlement checks are not implemented.
auth.sessionForQa: Playwright storage state supplied at runtime. Tests must not embed credentials.

contentSafety: Guided demo states that no signup is required.
Starter Kit copy separates CONFIRMED FACT, AI INTERPRETATION, and RECOMMENDED ACTION.
Prompts forbid inventing deadlines and forbid sending email or changing calendar events.
Safety guidance tells the person to review connector permissions before authorizing.
The workflow is described as summarize, prioritize, and recommend, not as a silent actor.
Worksheet answers and checklist progress are not saved to Atlas.
Local and App prices are labeled as planned or pilot, not as an active Atlas purchase.
Third-party AI plan limits and fees are called out.
Starter Kit, auth, and My Blueprints pages are noindex.
qaAcceptanceCriteria: Public use-case page loads without authentication.
Guided demo is available without authentication.
ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini selector shows one Supademo and loads the selected embed.
Logged-out Starter Kit access redirects to auth and preserves next.
Logged-out protected resource access redirects to auth and preserves next.
Logged-out My Blueprints access redirects to auth and preserves next.
When a storage state is provided: Starter Kit home loads and every resource is Ready.
When a storage state is provided: Initial Prompt and Priority Rules Prompt load, and Copy Prompt writes the prompt.
When a storage state is provided: the worksheet accepts input and the generated prompt omits empty rules.
When a storage state is provided: the review checklist toggles and resets.
When a storage state is provided: My Blueprints shows the free Starter Kit, and sign-out removes access.
Core public and auth pages have no unexpected console errors at desktop and mobile viewport sizes.
